search.query: $base_search$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | stats count by group_value | sort group_value
| inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | stats count by datamodel | sort datamodel

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | eval selected_group=if(len("$selected_group$")=0,"*","$selected_group$") | eval selected_group_wrapped="|" . selected_group . "|" | where selected_group="*" OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|" . group_value . "|%") | eventstats values(tag) as observed_tags count as event_count by group_value | fields group_value observed_tags event_count * | fields - _raw _time _indextime _cd _serial linecount punct splunk_server splunk_server_group | untable group_value field_name field_value | where isnotnull(field_value) | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where field_name!="group_value" | where field_name!="observed_tags" | where field_name!="event_count" | stats count as field_instances values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count by group_value field_name | join type=inner max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval model_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | fields datamodel field_name field_status recommended required model_field notes ] | eval field_scope_match=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND model_field=1,1, true(),0 )

| inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval model_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | eval field_scope_match=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND model_field=1,1, true(),0 ) | where field_scope_match=1 | stats dc(field_name) as total_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_field=1,field_name,null()))) as total_required_recommended_fields dc(eval(if(required=1,field_name,null()))) as total_required_fields by datamodel

div.div: Information Nexus for investigating CIM alignment, datamodel coverage, field evidence, tagging observations and acceleration readiness indicators.

search.query: | where field_scope_match=1 | stats dc(field_name) as matched_scope_fields values(observed_tags) as observed_tags by datamodel | join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=case( "$field_scope$"="all",1, "$field_scope$"="recommended" AND (recommended=1 OR required=1),1, true(),0 ) | where scope_field=1 | stats dc(field_name) as total_scope_fields by datamodel ] | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | join type=left max=0 datamodel_key [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | eval tag_role=lower(trim(coalesce(tag_role,"supporting"))) | eval coverage_set=coalesce(coverage_set,"_default") | where tag_role="top_level" | fields datamodel_key expected_tag tag_role coverage_set ] | eval tag_hit=if(isnotnull(expected_tag) AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tag)>=0,1,0) | stats min(eval(if(tag_role="top_level",tag_hit,null()))) as top_ok max(matched_scope_fields) as matched_scope_fields max(total_scope_fields) as total_scope_fields by datamodel coverage_set | eval set_complete=if(isnull(top_ok),0,if(top_ok=1,1,0)) | stats max(set_complete) as top_level_tag_observed max(matched_scope_fields) as matched_scope_fields max(total_scope_fields) as total_scope_fields by datamodel | eval field_alignment_pct=if(total_scope_fields>0,round((matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,2),0) | eval current_alignment_pct=if(top_level_tag_observed=1,field_alignment_pct,0) | eval potential_alignment_pct=if(top_level_tag_observed=0,field_alignment_pct,0) | where current_alignment_pct>0 OR potential_alignment_pct>0 | eval "Current Alignment %"=case("$dm_perspective$"="operational" OR "$dm_perspective$"="current" OR "$dm_perspective$"="combined",current_alignment_pct,true(),null()) | eval "Potential Alignment %"=case("$dm_perspective$"="potential" OR "$dm_perspective$"="combined",potential_alignment_pct,true(),null()) | table datamodel "Current Alignment %" "Potential Alignment %" | sort - "Current Alignment %" - "Potential Alignment %" datamodel

div.p: What this shows: Field-based alignment for datamodels detected in the selected data, with readiness context provided by CIM tag evidence elsewhere on this page.
How to use it: Use this to understand which datamodels have enough field evidence to justify deeper onboarding, acceleration, or governance review.

Read it as: Current alignment shows field coverage where the expected top-level CIM tag is observed. Potential alignment shows field coverage for datamodels where matching fields exist but the top-level tag is not observed.

search.query: | where field_scope_match=1 | stats dc(field_name) as matched_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_field=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_required_recommended_fields dc(eval(if(required=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_required_fields sum(field_instances) as field_instances max(event_count) as event_count by datamodel group_value | join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval model_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | eval field_scope_match=case("$field_scope$"="all",1,"$field_scope$"="recommended" AND model_field=1,1,true(),0) | where field_scope_match=1 | stats dc(field_name) as total_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_field=1,field_name,null()))) as total_required_recommended_fields dc(eval(if(required=1,field_name,null()))) as total_required_fields by datamodel ] | eval coverage_pct=if(total_scope_fields>0,round((matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,2),0) | eval recommended_coverage_pct=if(total_required_recommended_fields>0,round((matched_required_recommended_fields/total_required_recommended_fields)*100,2),0) | eval required_coverage_pct=if(total_required_fields>0,round((matched_required_fields/total_required_fields)*100,2),0) | rename datamodel as Datamodel | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename total_scope_fields as "Total Scope Fields" | rename matched_scope_fields as "Matched Scope Fields" | rename coverage_pct as "Field Coverage %" | rename recommended_coverage_pct as "Recommended Field Alignment %" | rename required_coverage_pct as "Required Coverage %" | rename event_count as "Events Checked" | table Datamodel "Data Source" "Events Checked" "Total Scope Fields" "Matched Scope Fields" "Field Coverage %" "Recommended Field Alignment %" "Required Coverage %" field_instances | sort Datamodel "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: The fields observed in the data that match selected datamodel definitions.
How to use it: Use this as the evidence trail for why a datamodel was considered relevant.
Read it as: Fields marked required or recommended are usually stronger evidence than optional fields.

search.query: | stats sum(field_instances) as field_instances values(field_status) as field_status max(required) as required max(recommended) as recommended values(notes) as notes by datamodel field_name group_value | eval field_importance=case(required=1,"Required", recommended=1,"Recommended", true(),"Optional") | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename datamodel as Datamodel | rename field_name as Field | rename field_instances as "Field Instances" | rename field_importance as "Field Importance" | table Datamodel "Data Source" Field "Field Importance" "Field Instances" | sort Datamodel "Data Source" "Field Importance" - "Field Instances" Field

div.p: What this shows: Required or recommended datamodel fields that were not observed in the selected data sample.
How to use it: Use this to guide onboarding discussions and to understand what may be limiting CIM/datamodel usefulness.
Read it as: A missing field does not always mean the data is bad. It may mean the field is not applicable, not extracted, or absent in the sample period.

search.query: | where field_scope_match=1 | stats dc(field_name) as matched by datamodel group_value field_name | appendpipe [ | stats values(group_value) as group_value by datamodel | mvexpand group_value | join type=inner max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | where recommended=1 OR required=1 | fields datamodel field_name field_status recommended required ] | eval matched=0 ] | stats max(matched) as matched values(field_status) as field_status max(recommended) as recommended max(required) as required values(notes) as notes by datamodel group_value field_name | where matched=0 | eval field_importance=case(required=1,"Required", recommended=1,"Recommended", true(),"Optional") | rename datamodel as Datamodel | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename field_name as "Missing Field" | rename field_importance as "Field Importance" | table Datamodel "Data Source" "Missing Field" "Field Importance" notes | sort Datamodel "Data Source" "Field Importance" "Missing Field"

div.p: What this shows: Required coverage tags and supporting CIM tags for matched datamodels compared with tags observed in the selected data.
How to use it: Use this to separate potential field alignment from operational datamodel readiness.

Read it as: Coverage requires all top-level tags for at least one root dataset (for example network + communicate for Network Traffic). Unique parent tags such as inventory or performance are enough on their own. Supporting tags add dataset context but are not sufficient alone.

search.query: | where field_scope_match=1 | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | stats dc(field_name) as matched_fields values(observed_tags) as observed_tags by datamodel datamodel_key group_value | join type=left max=0 datamodel_key [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel_key=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory","Compute_Inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines","JVM", true(),replace(datamodel," ","_") ) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | eval tag_role=lower(trim(coalesce(tag_role,"supporting"))) | eval coverage_set=coalesce(coverage_set,"_default") | stats values(eval(if(tag_role="top_level",expected_tag,null()))) as top_level_tags values(eval(if(tag_role="supporting",expected_tag,null()))) as supporting_tags values(eval(if(tag_role="constraint",expected_tag,null()))) as constraint_tags values(expected_tag) as expected_tags by datamodel_key coverage_set ] | eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | eval expected_tags=coalesce(expected_tags,"No expected tags mapped") | eval top_level_tags=coalesce(top_level_tags,"No top-level tags mapped") | eval supporting_tags=coalesce(supporting_tags,"No supporting tags mapped") | eval constraint_tags=coalesce(constraint_tags,"No constraint tags mapped") | eval observed_tags=coalesce(observed_tags,"No observed tags") | eval top_level_eval=top_level_tags | mvexpand top_level_eval | eval top_hit=case( top_level_eval="No top-level tags mapped",null(), observed_tags="No observed tags",0, mvfind(observed_tags, top_level_eval)>=0,1, true(),0 ) | stats values(top_level_tags) as top_level_tags values(supporting_tags) as supporting_tags values(constraint_tags) as constraint_tags values(observed_tags) as observed_tags min(top_hit) as top_ok max(matched_fields) as matched_fields by datamodel group_value coverage_set | eval set_complete=case( isnull(top_ok),"unknown", top_ok=1,"yes", true(),"no" ) | stats values(top_level_tags) as top_level_tags values(supporting_tags) as supporting_tags values(constraint_tags) as constraint_tags values(observed_tags) as observed_tags values(set_complete) as set_complete max(matched_fields) as matched_fields by datamodel group_value | eval coverage_observed=case( mvfind(set_complete,"yes")>=0,"yes", mvfind(set_complete,"no")>=0,"no", true(),"unknown" ) | eval top_level_tags=mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(top_level_tags)),", ") | eval supporting_tags=mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(supporting_tags)),", ") | eval constraint_tags=mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(constraint_tags)),", ") | eval observed_tags=mvjoin(mvsort(observed_tags),", ") | rename datamodel as Datamodel | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename top_level_tags as "Top-Level Tags" | rename supporting_tags as "Supporting Tags" | rename constraint_tags as "Constraint Tags" | rename observed_tags as "Observed Tags" | rename coverage_observed as "Coverage Tags Observed" | rename matched_fields as "Matched Fields" | table Datamodel "Data Source" "Matched Fields" "Top-Level Tags" "Supporting Tags" "Constraint Tags" "Observed Tags" "Coverage Tags Observed" | sort Datamodel "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: Whether matched datamodels appear to have Splunk datamodel acceleration enabled.
How to use it: Use this to identify where well-aligned data may support faster searches, dashboards, or Enterprise Security use cases.
Read it as: Acceleration should be reviewed against search demand, data volume, and platform capacity before enabling.

search.query: | stats dc(field_name) as matched_fields by datamodel | eval datamodel_alias=case( lower(datamodel)="inventory", "compute_inventory", lower(datamodel)="java virtual machines", "jvm", true(), datamodel ) | eval datamodel_norm=replace(lower(datamodel_alias),"[^a-z0-9]","") | join type=left max=0 datamodel_norm [ | rest /services/data/models | rename title as rest_datamodel | eval datamodel_alias=case( lower(rest_datamodel)="compute_inventory", "compute_inventory", lower(rest_datamodel)="jvm", "jvm", true(), rest_datamodel ) | eval datamodel_norm=replace(lower(datamodel_alias),"[^a-z0-9]","") | eval acceleration_enabled=case(acceleration=1 OR acceleration="1" OR acceleration="true", "yes", isnotnull(acceleration), "no", true(), "unknown") | eval acceleration_summary_range=coalesce('acceleration.earliest_time',"") | fields datamodel_norm rest_datamodel acceleration_enabled acceleration_summary_range ] | eval acceleration_enabled=coalesce(acceleration_enabled,"not found") | eval acceleration_summary_range=coalesce(acceleration_summary_range,"") | rename datamodel as Datamodel | rename rest_datamodel as "REST Datamodel" | rename matched_fields as "Matched Fields" | rename acceleration_enabled as "Acceleration Enabled" | rename acceleration_summary_range as "Acceleration Summary Range" | table Datamodel "Matched Fields" "Acceleration Enabled" "Acceleration Summary Range" | sort - "Matched Fields" Datamodel
